description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and support the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations and staff development. You will play a crucial part in maintaining high standards of care and ensuring regulatory compliance.

This position offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year. We are actively looking for an individual who is passionate about geriatric care and committed to fostering a supportive and efficient nursing environment. If you are an experienced nurse leader ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Registered Nurse (RN) license
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with leadership experience preferred
Knowledge of long-term care regulations and best practices
